core_assembly.name: Cu2(AnCOO)4(4-RPy)2
core_assembly.bridge_ligand: 9-anthracenecarboxylate anion, four carboxylate bridges in a Cu2 paddlewheel
core_assembly.axial_binding: one pyridine N bound axially to each Cu
core_assembly.states: lowest singlet and triplet states of the dimer

observables.J_definition: J = E_S - E_T; negative J denotes a lower singlet; report cm^-1.
observables.triplet_population: 100 * 3 * exp(J/(kBT)) / (1 + 3 * exp(J/(kBT))); T=300 K, kB=0.69503476 cm^-1/K when J is in cm^-1.
observables.expanded_matrix: All three members require relaxed and common-core spin comparisons. Use calculation_records/results in the submission contract for attempts, calibration and effects.
